exit.$description: Things leaving: the outgoing scene in a hand-off

stagger.$description: The gap between siblings settling in one after another

handoff.$description: How long an incoming scene waits for the outgoing one, so they never double-expose

toast.$description: How long the toast stays (CSS animation and the timer that clears it)

untap.$description: The Konami untap (CSS animation and the timer that ends it)

spring.$description: The prints springing back after a nudge

breakpoint.$description: Layout breakpoints. CSS uses them as custom media (src/styles/media.css: `@media (--md)` is from md up, `(--below-md)` under it); TypeScript gets them as numbers and queries.

xs.$description: Small phones: boxes stack their label over the text

stage.$description: From here, scroll scenes share one sticky stage

short.$description: A short window (a phone on its side): `(--short)`, `(--not-short)`, `(--landscape-short)`
